home.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
home.faq.subtitle: What to know before starting a carpentry project
home.faq.q1: What carpentry services does ef-sinn offer in Munich?
home.faq.a1: ef-sinn offers a wide range of carpentry services in Munich and Unterhaching: custom furniture (tables, beds, shelves, sideboards), built-in kitchens, built-in wardrobes, bathroom furniture, parquet installation and sanding, wooden staircases, wooden terraces, interior fit-out (wood ceilings, wall cladding), as well as furniture repair and restoration.
home.faq.q2: Does ef-sinn lay parquet flooring in Munich?
home.faq.a2: Yes. We lay solid and engineered parquet, wide timber floorboards and block parquet in Munich and the surrounding area. We also sand, oil and seal existing parquet floors.
home.faq.q3: Can you make furniture for unusual spaces or specific needs?
home.faq.a3: Yes. We design furniture around specific needs such as unusual dimensions, a particular timber, accessible layouts or built-in technology.
home.faq.q4: How much does bespoke furniture cost in Munich?
home.faq.a4: The cost depends on the materials, size, complexity and finish. We put together a quote for your project after discussing the details with you. Email info@ef-sinn.de or call +49 176 8718 6451.
home.faq.q5: What is the difference between a Schreiner and a Tischler?
home.faq.a5: Schreiner and Tischler are two German terms for the same profession – carpenter or joiner. In Bavaria and southern Germany the term "Schreiner" is used, while in northern and eastern Germany "Tischler" is preferred. The training, skills and activities are identical. ef-sinn in Munich is your carpenter for custom woodwork.
home.faq.a6: ef-sinn is based in Munich and Unterhaching and serves customers across Munich, Unterhaching, Taufkirchen, Ottobrunn, Neubiberg, Oberhaching, Grünwald, Pullach and the greater Munich/Upper Bavaria area.
home.faq.q7: What happens once I get in touch?
home.faq.a7: Tell us about your project first. We will then discuss how to carry out the work, take measurements and prepare a quote. We agree the making and fitting arrangements with you.
home.faq.q8: What types of timber do you use?
home.faq.a8: We work with oak, beech, ash, walnut, cherry and other timbers. We favour locally sourced timber from well-managed forests and can advise on what will suit your project.

home.cta.text: Tell us what you have in mind and we can discuss how to make it work in your space.

legal.privacy.body:
1. Privacy at a glance

General information

This privacy notice explains which personal data is processed when you visit this website or contact ef-sinn.

Data collected on this website

We use no tracking cookies, embedded maps or externally hosted fonts. The enquiry assistant prepares a preview of your message in your browser. You can copy the text, save it as a file or open it in your email app. The website does not submit your form to a server.

2. Data controller

The data controller for this website is
Marios Karampas
Schmorellstraße 6
82008 Unterhaching
Telephone: +49 176 8718 6451
Email: info@ef-sinn.de

3. Hosting and server logs

This website is hosted on GitHub Pages. The provider is GitHub Inc., 88 Colin P. Kelly Jr. Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA. When you visit the site, technical data may be processed, including your IP address, the date and time of your visit, browser type, operating system, referring URL and the file requested.

We process this data to deliver the website, keep it running reliably and protect it from misuse. The legal basis is Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. Our legitimate interest is keeping the website secure and reliable.

GitHub Pages may transfer data to the United States. GitHub states that it participates in the EU–US Data Privacy Framework. The European Commission’s adequacy decision applies to transfers to US recipients covered by that framework (Article 45 GDPR). For details on processing and international transfers, see the GitHub Privacy Statement.

4. Contacting us

When you contact us by telephone or email, we process the information you provide. This may include your name, contact details, a description of the project, measurements, photos and the contents of your message. We use this data to handle your enquiry, communicate with you and prepare a quote where appropriate.

The legal basis is Article 6(1)(b) GDPR where your enquiry concerns a contract or steps before entering into one. In other cases, the legal basis is Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. Our legitimate interest is handling your enquiry properly.

Our email inbox is hosted by Proton AG, based in Switzerland. Proton processes the data needed to provide its email service, such as the message and its delivery information. The European Commission has adopted an adequacy decision for transfers to Switzerland (Article 45 GDPR). For more information, see the Proton Mail privacy policy.

AI assistance with email enquiries

We use the Hermes AI assistant to review email enquiries and prepare replies. When this involves OpenAI Codex, OpenAI receives the details from your message that are passed to the model for that step. These details may include personal data.

For information about possible processing outside the European Economic Area, safeguards for transfers such as adequacy decisions and standard contractual clauses, and data retention, see the OpenAI Privacy Policy.

5. Enquiry assistant

The enquiry assistant first processes your details in the open browser tab. Select “Review enquiry” to open a preview. Reviewing and editing your draft do not send it. The assistant does not save your details in persistent browser storage.

Select “Open email app” to request that your email app open. If your message is long, only the recipient and subject are filled in, and you paste in the full draft yourself. “Copy text” copies the draft to your clipboard, and “Save as text” provides a text file you can save on your device. Add any photos in your email app. The website does not upload photos. We receive your details when you send the email yourself.

6. Language choice, tracking and external content

If you choose a language, your browser saves the language code for the current session in that tab (Session Storage). This keeps your language choice when you move between pages. The code is used only for this function (Section 25(2), no. 2 TDDDG). The website uses no tracking cookies or analytics tools. Links can open external services such as Google Maps when you choose to follow them. We do not embed that content on the website. The relevant provider’s privacy policy applies when you follow an external link.

7. How long we keep your data

If an enquiry does not lead to an order, we keep the data for as long as needed to deal with your enquiry and where the record is still needed to resolve follow-up questions or legal claims. If you place an order, we keep the data needed to carry out the work and to the extent required by the applicable statutory retention obligations.

8. Your rights

Subject to the applicable legal conditions, you have the right to access, correct and erase your data, to restrict processing, to data portability and to object to certain processing. You can withdraw any consent you have given at any time, with effect for the future.

Right to object

You may object at any time, on grounds relating to your particular situation, to the processing of personal data based on Article 6(1)(f) GDPR (Article 21(1) GDPR).

9. Right to complain

You have the right to complain to a data protection supervisory authority. In Bavaria, you can contact the Bavarian State Office for Data Protection Supervision (Bayerisches Landesamt für Datenschutzaufsicht) at www.lda.bayern.de.

10. SSL and TLS encryption

The website uses HTTPS where possible. This helps protect data sent between your browser and the website from being read by third parties.

contact.ai.title: Drafting a project enquiry with an AI assistant
contact.ai.text: You can ask an AI assistant to draft an email using the project type, location, approximate dimensions, preferred materials and timing. If you know them, give the parquet area in square metres (m²) and the length of skirting boards in linear metres. Review and send the email yourself. Add personal contact details and photos in your email app.
